properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real OpenStreetMap building footprint for One Mission Bay, a 350-unit, two-building (a 13-16 story tower plus a 6-story perimeter building, sources disagree on the tower's exact story count) waterfront condominium development at 110 Channel St/1000 3rd St, developed by CIM Group and Strada Investment Group, designed by Arquitectonica, completed 2018. Point-in-polygon checked against DataSF's official redevelopment-area layer: this site falls in Mission Bay South, not Mission Bay North as this project's own brief informally grouped it. CORRECTED 2026-09-19: the owner flagged (relaying a claim from another AI tool, which was checked here rather than trusted directly) that this record covers only part of the real development. Confirmed via the DataSF Assessor: 110 Channel St and 1000 3rd St condo units (many individual unit blklots under block 8715) all geocode to the same point, which is the centroid of blklot 8715007 -- a common-area/master lot with no street address of its own, distinct from a per-unit lot. That master lot's own boundary extends beyond this record's original OSM-sourced tower footprint (confirmed visually against satellite: the tracked shape stopped short of part of the building massing near the shared courtyard/pool area). Geometry replaced with the union of the original OSM tower way and Assessor blklot 8715007's real boundary -- both real, surveyed sources, combined rather than either alone. Did not add the 'approximately 50,000 sq ft of retail' figure the owner's AI-tool source gave: the only primary-adjacent source found for that number is older marketing copy describing planned retail for the surrounding Mission Bay neighborhood as a whole (alongside the UCSF hospital and the then-under-construction Chase Center), not specifically this building's own ground floor -- left out per the never-fabricate rule rather than asserted on an unverified attribution. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) Blklot 8715007 is not a current common-area/master lot with no address: DataSF Parcels (acdm-wktn, queried 2026-09-29) shows it as a RETIRED parcel (active false, mapped 2014-02-11, dropped 2016-11-16), and the Assessor roll carries it through 2017 with property location 110 Channel St; no active lot carries it as mapblklot. The union shape includes this superseded boundary (geometry not changed in this audit; owner to decide). (2) The story count and building split are not settled: the cited Compass page says 16 stories, OSM building:levels is 17, and no cited source gives '13 stories' or a '6-story perimeter building'. (3) 'Developed by CIM Group and Strada Investment Group, designed by Arquitectonica' is not supported by the cited sources: Strada's page says only that it 'partnered with the buyer' (unnamed), and no cited source names Arquitectonica. (4) 'Completed 2018' is from Strada's page ('completed in 2018'). 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- union of a surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint and the boundary of blklot 8715007, a RETIRED DataSF parcel (active false; mapped 2014-02-11, dropped 2016-11-16; last Assessor roll 2017, property location 110 Channel St), not a hand trace or plan estimate -- the shape therefore includes a superseded boundary, and whether to keep it is the owner's call. The per-unit condo lots were not identified in the 2026-09 audit (no active lot in DataSF Parcels carries mapblklot 8715007), and no single per-unit blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can; blklot 8715007, a retired parcel, is the exception used here. Real-geometry-without-a-single-owner-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.'; notes: '350 condominium units across two connected structures (a high-rise tower plus a lower perimeter building) at 1000 3rd St and 110 Channel St; Strada's project page lists 350 units and 20,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, and the Compass building page lists a pool and concierge (other amenities and the 495-1,528 sq ft unit sizes are not confirmed by any cited page). A claimed ~50,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail could not be confirmed as specific to this building (see digitization_method) -- not asserted here.'. REPLACED 2026-10-12 (shape; status and use unchanged): the owner approved building records whose outline matches an Assessor lot at 85% or better, both ways, using the lot (CLAUDE.md, 'An official parcel beats our drawing'). DataSF's Assessor layer (data/raw/parcels.geojson) has the union of Assessor lots 8715208 and 8715009 (8,894 m2, active, mapped 2016-11-16); the earlier outline of 7,576 m2 and the lot overlap with IoU 0.76 (94% of the earlier outline lies inside the lot and it covers 80% of the lot). The outline is now their union using the lots' own vertices (no simplification). geometry_type stays 'real'. Previous digitized_from: 'OpenStreetMap (way 563104192, name=One Mission Bay), unioned with the boundary of retired DataSF parcel blklot 8715007'. Previous accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- union of a surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint and the boundary of blklot 8715007, a RETIRED DataSF parcel (active false; mapped 2014-02-11, dropped 2016-11-16; last Assessor roll 2017, property location 110 Channel St), not a hand trace or plan estimate -- the shape therefore includes a superseded boundary, and whether to keep it has not been decided. The per-unit condo lots were not identified in a September 2026 check (no active lot in DataSF Parcels carries mapblklot 8715007), and no single per-unit blklot represents the whole building so the building cannot be mapped from a single Assessor parcel the way a single-owner building can; blklot 8715007, a retired parcel, is the exception used here. Real-geometry-without-a-single-owner-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.'. 2026-10-12 accuracy audit follow-up: the notes described the buildings as 'two connected structures (a high-rise tower plus a lower perimeter building)' and the Compass page as listing 'a pool and concierge'. Re-read: Strada's page says only 'Strada partnered with the buyer to construct the two One Mission Bay residential buildings.' and lists '350 units' and '20,000 sqft retail'; it does not call the buildings connected or describe a tower plus a perimeter building. The Compass building page ('350 Units, 16 Stories'; marked 'Updated as of May 31, 2022') lists under Building Amenities 'Business Center Cabana Elevator Garage Parking Available Pool Sauna Spa Waterfront'; 'Concierge' appears only in the site's footer navigation, not as an amenity of the building. The notes now say two buildings and name the amenities the page lists. The developer and architect named in the ADDED entry (CIM Group, Strada Investment Group, Arquitectonica) remain unsupported, as the 2026-09-29 entry above already says. No change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type. 2026-10-13 (text only; no change to the shape): the sentence that named the public data repository's address was reworded to refer to this shape's mapping log by name, so no raw repository address prints on the page. The tracing history is unchanged.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is the union of Assessor lots 8715208 and 8715009 (8,894 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the union of an OpenStreetMap building footprint (way 563104192) and the boundary of retired parcel 8715007; 94% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 80% of the lot. Both lots are condominium-mapped: map lot 8715208 (110 and 112 Channel St) is shared by 153 Assessor lots and map lot 8715009 (1000 3rd St) by another 153; each outline is the building's shared lot, not any one unit. Retired parcels 8715007 and 8715006 had the same outlines and were dropped from the map on 2016-11-16, the day these two lots were added; no retired parcel is used now. About 6% of the earlier outline lay outside these two lots, mostly on the neighbouring promenade lot 8714002. The Luma Hotel (lot 8715008) sits between the two buildings and is a separate record.
properties.notes: 350 condominium units in two buildings at 1000 3rd St and 110 Channel St (Strada's project page refers to 'the two One Mission Bay residential buildings'; no cited source gives their heights or says how they relate, and the Compass page says 16 stories while OpenStreetMap has 17 levels); Strada's project page lists 350 units and 20,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, and the Compass building page (marked 'Updated as of May 31, 2022') lists a pool, sauna, spa, cabana and business center among its building amenities (it does not list a concierge; other amenities and the 495-1,528 sq ft unit sizes are not confirmed by any cited page). A claimed ~50,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail could not be confirmed as specific to this building -- not asserted here. How this shape was traced, including earlier versions, is logged in its mapping log.
